    # Drug columns: B (Gemcitabine, col2), C (Paclitaxel, col3), D (SN-38, col4), E (5-FU, col5), F (Oxaliplatin, col6) (1-based)

        cell_ref('supp.xlsx', 'Chemo ', row_num, 6)
    ]
